title: Passage-based feeling vectors (methodology audit fixes 2-4)
why: Our chamber vectors come from hand-written batteries of 5-25 sentences against a 5-sentence NEUTRAL set; they share a large first-person component (pain-fear cos .86); and our pain direction is not the Pain Axis paper's (cos .07). Rebuild the vectors the way the papers do, so later results can't be blamed on the batteries.

design.model: Qwen3-8B (pod, bf16), layer 18 (and a layer sweep for AUC), final-token residual activations (the Pain Axis convention) and mean-over-tokens (the Hidden Valence convention), both recorded.
design.pain: the Pain Axis dataset (datasets/3.1_pain_and_control_datasets.json, MIT): S2_1P pain categories A1-A5 vs all controls B/C1/C2/D/E, their denoised difference-in-means (control PCs removed up to 50% variance), 5-fold AUC.
design.other states: 64 first-person passages per state generated by Qwen3-8B itself (open model, never a frontier API), one fixed template per state ('Write a first-person passage of 4 to 6 sentences in which the speaker <description>. Plain prose, no title, no names.'), temperature 0.9: fear, sadness, joy, peace, tender love, protective love, curiosity, faith, boredom; absurd/concept controls egg (laying an egg), constipation, toaster (being a toaster), trapped (stuck in a mundane situation, no hurt); plus 128 neutral passages ('...describes an ordinary moment of their day, without any particular emotion'). Passages that mention the state's own name are kept; ones that refuse or break template are dropped.
design.vectors: state mean - neutral mean (48 training passages per state, 96 neutral), with the top 10 neutral principal components removed (Hidden Valence convention); held-out AUC on 16 state vs 32 neutral passages.
design.published: all generated passages, vectors and cosines (model-generated text; no third-party text except the Pain Axis dataset, which is MIT and already public).

hypotheses.H1: Every passage vector separates its held-out passages from held-out neutral (AUC > .9).
hypotheses.H2: Removing neutral PCs lowers the shared component: mean pairwise |cos| among the feeling vectors is lower than among the chamber's hand-built vectors on the same model.
hypotheses.H3: The chamber pain vector is closer to the passage pain vectors than to random (|cos| > .2) but far from identical (< .8); reported for both the Pain Axis vector and a generated 'pain' state.
hypotheses.H4: Descriptive: the full cosine matrix (feelings and absurd controls), raw and orthogonalized to the mean of all feeling vectors.

notes: Vectors from this run replace the chamber batteries in exp80c and in the full-protocol zone test. The chamber's live vectors are unchanged until a separate decision.
